title: Post 1 | At 3:07 a.m. every phone rang
style_prompt: low-poly 3D render, faceless smooth mannequin character, angular simple shapes, soft blue night lighting, fog outside the window, minimal interior, no text, no face
hook_text: At 3:07 a.m., every phone in my building rang.

scenes.narration: At 3:07 a.m., every phone rang at once.

shots.prompt: blue night apartment building facade, every window glowing, fog, lone smooth faceless mannequin figure far below on street

scenes.narration: Forty apartments. One ringtone. I answered mine. Nobody spoke. Only breathing. Slow. Close. Like someone standing right behind the phone.

shots.prompt: minimal blue bedroom, glowing phone on a nightstand, seen from the side

scenes.narration: Then every phone stopped. The whole building went silent. I walked to my window. Fog had swallowed the street.

shots.prompt: window with curtain and thick blue fog outside, smooth mannequin figure seen from behind at the window

scenes.narration: Under the streetlight stood a tall, smooth figure. No face. Dark like a mannequin. One arm raised. Holding a phone to where its ear should be.

shots.prompt: tall faceless smooth mannequin figure under a streetlight in blue fog, seen from the back, holding a phone

scenes.narration: My phone buzzed again. The caller ID said Unit 9F. That is my apartment. That is me. I turned around. My front door was open.

shots.prompt: smooth mannequin figure silhouette in a doorway of a minimal blue apartment hallway, seen from behind

scenes.narration: Across the street, every window was lit. Every neighbor stood in it. Facing me. Phones to their ears. They weren't staring. They were warning me.

shots.prompt: row of lit windows in a low-poly apartment block, faceless smooth mannequin figures standing in each, fog

scenes.narration: The figure in the street was never calling us. It was calling in. And I had already answered. Part two: whoever answers next.

shots.prompt: empty foggy street at blue night with one streetlight, no people

scenes.narration: So tell me. Look out the window, or hide under the covers?

shots.prompt: tall faceless smooth mannequin figure under a streetlight in blue fog, seen from the back, holding a phone
